ShinyApp_5_Function_Reference.Rmd

Functions included in the av_runShiny() app

This vignette will give details about included functions in the av_runShiny() app. It will describe usage (including parameters) and formulas behind the outputs, and provide pointers and examples as needed. This vignette is not comprehensive, as many of the functions are self-evident from the documentation or help strings.
